theorems.name: Submission.dpf_itt_comp_bilipschitz_piece
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L Λ Λ' : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L F → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ F a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ F a)) → Differentiable ℝ φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → LipschitzWith Λ φ → AntilipschitzWith Λ' φ → LipschitzWith (Λ * L) (φ ∘ F) ∧ (∃ m' : ℝ, 0 < m' ∧ ∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m' * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖(φ ∘ F) a - (φ ∘ F) a'‖) ∧ (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ ∘ F) a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ F) a)) ∧ ∀ a ∈ B, LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ F) a : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = Submodule.map (fderiv ℝ φ (F a) : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F a : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
